channel_not_found: This channel no longer exists. It may have been deleted; refresh the list.
channel_search_backend_managed: This channel is a search backend, so it cannot be changed here. Manage it on the Search backends page.
channel_lane_invalid: Lane “{{lane}}” does not exist. A channel belongs to exactly one existing lane; pick one from the list.
channel_settings_invalid: The channel's extra settings could not be read, so nothing was saved. Check the JSON format and values.
channel_model_name_too_long: A model name is longer than 255 characters, so the channel was not saved. Shorten or remove it.
channel_not_multi_key: This channel uses a single key, so its keys cannot be managed one by one.
channel_key_index_invalid: That key is no longer in this channel. Refresh the key list and try again.
channel_last_key: This is the channel's last key, so it cannot be deleted. Add another key first, or delete the channel.
channel_keys_none_eligible: No key matches this action, so nothing changed.
channel_balance_unsupported: Balance lookup is not available for this channel type or for multi-key channels.
channel_balance_query_failed: The upstream did not return a balance. Check the channel's key and base URL, then try again.
channel_upstream_models_failed: The upstream did not return a model list. Check the key and base URL, or add models by hand.
channel_task_running: The same maintenance task is already running, so a new one was not started. Try again when it finishes.
channel_test_failed: The channel test failed: the upstream returned an error. Check the key, base URL and test model, then test again.
channel_test_not_sent: The test could not be built for this channel, so nothing was sent upstream. Check its type, model mapping and pricing.
channel_route_not_found: This channel does not serve that model in that lane. Refresh the page to see its current routes.
route_observation_incomplete: This source is still under observation. It can go live after seven days, once every check has passed.
route_observation_none: This source has no models under observation. Refresh the page to see its current state.
